Technical Specialist I, Biofuels, Lifecycle, GHG

SCS Global Services Hybrid · Brasília … 2 days ago

Job Description

Company Overview SCS Global Services is a pioneer and leader in sustainability standards and third‑party certification, serving natural resources, built environment, food & agriculture, consumer products, and climate sectors for over 40 years. As a Benefit Corporation, the company is committed to socially and environmentally responsible business practices and uses sound science to drive positive change.

Job Overview Recent growth in Renewable Fuels and Circular Economy has increased interest in certification programs such as ISCC EU, ISCC PLUS, RSB EU RED, and RSB Advanced Products. SCS has developed standardized protocols to evaluate GHG emissions from Life‑Cycle Assessments (LCAs) of biofuels and biobased products. The Technical Specialist I supports the ISCC and RSB certification teams globally, primarily conducting remote GHG reviews.

Relevant Standards/Schemes

  • International Sustainability & Carbon Certification (ISCC)
  • Roundtable on Sustainable Biomaterials (RSB)

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Technical Greenhouse Gas (GHG) Review (95%)

  • Complete and deliver GHG reports and related comments to auditors and program staff on time and according to program requirements
  • Interact with clients and audit teams to follow up on nonconformity closure when necessary
  • Support the development of new procedures and processes to review GHG calculations efficiently and effectively
  • Communicate in a timely and professional manner with internal staff and external clients

Greenhouse Gas LCA Calculations (5%)

  • Occasional support to companies not being certified by SCS to perform GHG emissions calculations (consulting activity)

Quality and Program Development

  • Deliver verification services in accordance with SCS Corporate and Program Quality requirements
  • Support the SCS quality management system through maintenance of competency records, training logs, calibration activities, and up‑to‑date knowledge of program and external scheme requirements

Minimum Qualifications

  • Master’s Degree in a technical field (e.g., chemistry or related) with 2+ years of experience completing LCAs for biofuels or bio‑based materials, according to ISO 14040/44 requirements, **or**
  • Bachelor’s Degree in a technical field (e.g., chemistry or related) with 5+ years of experience completing LCAs for biofuels or bio‑based materials, according to ISO 14040/44 requirements
  • Experience using ecoinvent database and major LCA software (e.g., SimaPro, GaBi, openLCA)
  • Experience working with international biofuels LCA models, including the EU RED (e.g., Biograce, GHGenius, RenovaCalc, GREET)
  • Understanding of Life‑Cycle Accounting principles, according to ISO 14064/65 and other international standards and guidelines (e.g., PEF framework, WRI GHG Protocol, Together for Sustainability guideline)
  • Strong technical writing, organization, and prioritization skills
  • Excellent time management skills with a proven ability to meet deadlines
  • Strong customer service and teamwork orientation
  • Complete fluency in English with professional experience that involves written and verbal communication
  • Proficient with business software including Outlook, Word, Excel, and database management
  • Initiative, good judgment, and ability to work independently under pressure in a changing environment

Preferred Qualifications

  • PhD in a technical field (e.g., chemistry or related)
  • Experience working with soil carbon accumulation and related models (e.g., RothC model, Century model, DAYCENT model)
  • Experience with LCA and GHG accounting for green hydrogen and e‑fuels
  • Knowledge of biofuel production, including biodiesel, HVO/renewable diesel, sustainable aviation fuel, and ethanol
  • Experience with bio‑based materials carbon intensity calculation, including bio‑based plastics and chemicals
  • Multi‑language proficiency

The above description is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, and skills required. Additional duties outside of normal responsibilities may be required from time to time as assigned.

Working Remotely

SCS is recruiting all open roles to be remote, allowing employees the flexibility to work from home and enabling the company to diversify its workforce. This is a home‑office based role and may include local, domestic, and/or international travel, as clarified during the recruitment process.

Sobre a Neon

Na Neon, cada ideia conta e pode transformar a vida financeira de milhares de brasileiras e brasileiros que acreditam que o céu é o limite. Buscamos pessoas que querem contribuir com impacto real e crescer junto com a gente!

Nosso ritmo é intenso, assim como o aprendizado com gente muito talentosa e equipes colaborativas que geram impacto real desde o primeiro dia, com o bônus de trabalhar de qualquer lugar do Brasil.

Aqui a inovação e tecnologia andam juntos e diversidade é decisão estratégica do negócio e compromisso que molda nossas decisões e garante um ambiente acolhedor para todas as pessoas.

Valorizamos a colaboração, o diálogo aberto e entregas que compreendam as necessidades das pessoas que usam nossas soluções. Se você é uma pessoa que gosta de construir, testar, aprender e se comprometer com a excelência, a Neon é pra você.

Vem fazer parte de um time que não tem medo de sonhar grande e trabalha junto para elevar a barra todos os dias, fazendo o dinheiro fluir e o mundo crescer. Vem #ViverNoAzul!

Estamos buscando uma pessoa PM para a squad de Cartões da Neon. O desafio principal é liderar a evolução da jornada de uso do cartão, equilibrando a robustez técnica da infraestrutura de pagamentos com uma cultura de experimentação focada na otimização da experiência do cliente e do TPV.

Responsabilidades

  • Atuará na intersecção entre rigor técnico — foco na gestão do autorizador, mandates e carteiras digitais — e validação de hipóteses de produto para melhorar conversão e engajamento.
  • Escopo abrange desde o momento da primeira transação até a recorrência de uso no dia a dia, exigindo forte articulação com squads de Crédito e Faturas para garantir resiliência dos fluxos e conformidade técnica perante bandeiras.
  • Realiza diagnósticos, com autonomia de dados, de performance transacional e agilidade para implementar melhorias que reduzam fricção no checkout e elevem taxas de autorização.

Requisitos

  • Experiência em Pagamentos: Conhecimento sólido em infraestrutura de cartões (emissão, processamento e autorização).
  • Perfil Híbrido: Equilíbrio entre profundidade técnica e visão de negócio (foco em engajamento).
  • Data-Driven: Autonomia total em análise de dados para realizar diagnósticos ágeis de performance e identificar gargalos de transação.
  • Atitude Hands-on: Conforto em atuar na execução técnica ao mesmo tempo em que define estratégia do roadmap.
  • Stakeholder Management: Forte habilidade de comunicação para alinhar dependências entre múltiplas squads e parceiros externos (Autorizador/Bandeiras).

Se vier fazer parte da Neon

É importante:

  • Adaptabilidade para lidar com diferentes cenários e desafios em um ambiente dinâmico.
  • Foco em resultados, com habilidade para priorizar o que gera mais impacto.
  • Autonomia e colaboração para trabalhar de forma produtiva no modelo remoto.

E o que você vai encontrar aqui?

  • Modelo de trabalho remoto de verdade, com encontros de time a cada 3 meses em São Paulo. Também tem crédito para compra de Kit Home Office e parceria para uso de coworkings.
  • Cartão iFood Benefícios - você personaliza seu pacote com benefícios de vale alimentação e refeição e mobilidade.
  • Gympass, com rede de academias e aulas online.
  • Apoio à parentalidade com auxílio creche ou babá e Licença parental estendida.
  • Assistência médica e odontológica.
  • Open English: pacotes de aulas com descontos exclusivos para Neowners e dependentes.
  • Desconto em MBAs e especializações na USP ESALQ.

LGPD na Neon

A Neon adota uma política para garantir controle e transparência no tratamento de dados de todas as pessoas, inclusive aquelas interessadas em fazer parte do nosso time. As informações de candidatos à vagas abertas na Neon durante o processo seletivo são tratadas rigorosamente de acordo com a LGPD.

Nossa declaração de Diversidade Equidade & Inclusão

Na JDE Peet's, nosso propósito é criar um futuro melhor, no qual servimos, refletimos e abraçamos todos em suas autenticidades. Acreditamos na promoção de uma organização mais diversa, equitativa e inclusiva, em que todos se sintam confortáveis para serem, verdadeiramente, quem são e possam despertar todo o seu potencial. Isto significa que não toleramos qualquer tipo de discriminação com base em raça ou etnia, identidade de gênero, orientação sexual, religião, nacionalidade, idade, deficiência ou qualquer outra característica diversa e protegida por lei.

Ao longo de todo o ciclo de vida dos associados, priorizamos DE&I no centro dos nossos processos de pessoas. Isso nos permite promover o respeito e eliminar qualquer preconceito ou ação discriminatória, garantindo uma experiência inclusiva no ambiente de trabalho. Descrição da empresa

Quem somos nós?

Somos a JDE Peet’s. Nós produzimos um café para cada xícara e desenvolvemos marcas para cada coração.

A JDE Peet’s é a principal empresa global dedicada exclusivamente ao café, servindo aproximadamente 4.400 xícaras de café por segundo em mais de 100 mercados. Guiados pela nossa estratégia “Reviver o Incrível”, focamos em um crescimento liderado por marcas com três grandes apostas: Peet’s, L’OR e Jacobs, além de um portfólio de 9 ícones locais, como Douwe Egberts, Kenco, Pilão, Old Town, Moccona, Super, Gevalia, Friele e Marcilla.

Em 2024, a JDE Peet’s gerou 8,8 bilhões de euros em vendas e contava com mais de 21 mil colaboradores no mundo todo.

No Brasil, somos uma das maiores empresas de café e temos atuação nacional com liderança absoluta em São Paulo e no Rio de Janeiro, através de nossas marcas Pilão, L’OR, Café do Ponto, Damasco, Café Maratá, Caboclo, Café Pelé, Café Puro, Chá Maratá e Chá Castelari.

Como é trabalhar na JDE Peet's?

Acreditamos que é incrível o que acontece ao redor de uma xícara de café.
Juntos, criamos esses momentos todos os dias, transformando ideias em impacto e possibilidades em realidade.

Na JDE Peet’s, trabalhamos como um só time, guiados por nossos valores: Ouse Encantar, Seja Dono, Simplifique e Vencer Juntos. Aqui, você encontra liberdade para inovar, coragem para dar passos ousados e apoio para desenvolver sua carreira em um ambiente global.

Venha fazer parte do nosso time e descubra qual é a sua xícara de momentos incríveis!

title: Gerente de PCP / PMO
description:
Estamos em busca de um(a) Gerente de PCP/PMO para liderar o setor de planejamento, controle da produção, gerenciamento de projetos e orçamentos. O(a) profissional será responsável por integrar o planejamento físico-financeiro com a gestão de custos e propostas comerciais, garantindo eficiência, competitividade e governança nos processos.

Requisitos

  • Formação superior em Engenharia Civil, Engenharia Mecânica ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência consolidada em PCP, PMO e orçamentos de obras corporativas, industriais ou logísticas.
  • Conhecimento sólido em elaboração de propostas técnicas e comerciais, composição de custos unitários e análise de BDI.
  • Domínio de ferramentas de planejamento e gestão (MS Project, Power BI, ERP/TOTVS ou similares).
  • Domínio de metodologias ágeis e tradicionais de gestão de projetos (PMBOK, Scrum, Lean, etc.).
  • Capacidade analítica, visão estratégica e habilidade de negociação.
  • Liderança comprovada em gestão de equipes multidisciplinares.

Diferenciais

  • MBA ou Pós-graduação em Gestão de Projetos, Engenharia de Produção ou Orçamento e Custos.
  • Certificações PMP, Scrum Master, Lean Six Sigma.
  • Experiência com BIM 4D/5D e integração físico-financeira.
  • Experiência em obras industriais.
  • Vivência em obras públicas e privadas, inclusive em processos licitatórios.

Gerenciar o setor de PCP (Planejamento e Controle da Produção) , estruturando e acompanhando cronogramas executivos de obras e projetos.

  • Atuar como PMO (Project Management Office) , estabelecendo metodologias, indicadores e processos de governança em gestão de projetos.
  • Coordenar a elaboração de orçamentos detalhados , estudos de viabilidade, composições de custo e propostas comerciais.
  • Estruturar e revisar BDI (Benefícios e Despesas Indiretas) , assegurando margens adequadas e competitividade em licitações e negociações.
  • Garantir o cumprimento de prazos, escopos e custos, propondo soluções para desvios identificados.
  • Coordenar a interface entre as áreas de engenharia, suprimentos, obras, projetos, diretoria e clientes.
  • Implementar e acompanhar indicadores de desempenho (KPIs) de produtividade, eficiência e qualidade.
  • Promover a padronização de processos, fluxos, relatórios e análises orçamentárias.
  • Conduzir reuniões de alinhamento, revisões de planejamento e apresentações de resultados para a alta gestão.
  • Apoiar a tomada de decisão estratégica com base em análises físico-financeiras e cenários de curto, médio e longo prazo.

title: Supervisor de Unidade - Bangu
description:
Grupo Ultra

A Ultra já nasceu acreditando que o esporte e a atividade física são capazes de transformar nós mesmos, o outro e também a sociedade.

Todos nós temos o poder de fazer a diferença. E se o mundo está tão diferente por que as academias são todas iguais?

Chegamos para fazer diferente.

Propósito

Existimos para ser uma ferramenta poderosa de transformação através de atividade física e esportes. Nascemos como um agente incansável de mudanças, incentivando, motivando e oferecendo a estrutura e serviços adequados para a prática de exercícios.

Responsabilidades e Atribuições do cargo

  • Supervisionar e coordenar a equipe e atividades da unidade.
  • Elaborar relatórios e atualizar relatórios com os indicadores e performance da unidade.
  • Monitorar os indicadores de desempenho da unidade e avaliar a equipe de forma coletiva e individual.
  • Participar, acompanhar e solucionar (quando possível) os itens avaliados em auditorias internas.
  • Realizar reuniões periódicas com a equipe (consultor de vendas, consultor fitness, coach de ginástica, limpeza e manutenção).
  • Acompanhar obras de reparo e equipes de manutenção, tanto como predial, equipamento e limpeza.
  • Fazer pesquisa na região com os concorrentes.
  • Capacitar e desenvolver todos os membros da equipe e de outras unidades.
  • Aplicar treinamento inicial e de reciclagem com novos membros e equipe já existente.
  • Tratar e responder todas as manifestações vindas NPS, SAC, Site e Redes Sociais ou pessoalmente dos alunos, ouvindo, avaliando e decidindo com imparcialidade.
  • Tratar e solucionar os conflitos com os alunos.
  • Supervisionar o atendimento de toda a equipe.
  • Controlar o estoque e suprimentos para unidade.
  • Coordenar toda a manutenção predial e de equipamentos, solicitar orçamentos e pesquisar melhores preços.
  • Entrevistar e selecionar pessoas para fazer parte da equipe (quando necessário).
  • Participar do processo de admissão de novos membros, receber e conferir os documentos admissionais dos membros aprovados e enviar para contabilidade.
  • Gerenciar o ponto eletrônico da unidade.
  • Auxiliar no processo administrativo da unidade, como admissão, demissão, férias, faltas, marcação de ponto, escala de trabalho, fechamento da folha, etc.
  • Zelar pela perfeita conservação, limpeza, proporcionando ordem no local de trabalho.
  • Executar outras tarefas correlatadas, conforme necessidade do serviço e orientação do superior imediato.

Grau de Instrução

Ensino superior em Educação Física, desejável graduação adicional em Administração, Gestão de Negócios ou Pessoas.

Habilidades

  • Boa comunicação.
  • Liderança.
  • Tratamento igualitário.
  • Planejamento e Organização.
  • Pontual e organizado(a).
  • Gostar de trabalhar com pessoas.

Requisitos

  • Pacote Office intermediário.
  • Gestão de pessoas e processos.
  • Curso de Scrum será um diferencial.

Informações Adicionais

Plano Vip Ultra para o colaborador e mais uma pessoa.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Aqui, seu papel faz a diferença todos os dias.

  • Realizar análise crítica das glosas médicas, técnicas e administrativas recebidas das operadoras de saúde;
  • Elaborar recursos administrativos com base em documentação clínica e contratual;

Requisitos e qualificações

Se você acredita que o cuidado começa com preparo e intenção, esse pode ser o seu lugar.

Para cuidar com a gente, é importante ter:

  • Ensino superior completo em Administração, Enfermagem, Gestão Hospitalar ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência anterior com recurso de glosas hospitalares;
  • Conhecimento de contratos com operadoras e tabelas de procedimentos (TUSS, CBHPM, AMB, entre outros);
  • Habilidade com leitura e interpretação de prontuários médicos;
  • Domínio do pacote Office (principalmente Excel);
  • Vivência com sistemas hospitalares (ex: Tasy, MV, Smart).

Informações adicionais

Local: Campinas - SP

Nosso cuidado começa dentro de casa, entregando o melhor para as nossas pessoas.

Na Rede Américas, valorizamos quem constrói o cuidado no dia a dia. Por isso, oferecemos benefícios pensados para o seu bem‑estar, desenvolvimento e qualidade de vida.

Benefícios

  • Cuidados com a alimentação: vale-alimentação, vale-refeição ou refeitório no local (de acordo com a unidade);
  • Cuidados com a saúde: Plano de saúde e Seguro de vida;

  • Outros: Vale Transporte, benefícios SESC e programas de reconhecimento.

Programa Bem Cuidar

  • Saúde mental e emocional: atendimento e acolhimento psicossocial especializado com psicólogos, psiquiatras e assistente social, de acordo com a necessidade de cuidado de cada pessoa;
  • Assistência social: acolhimento social remoto através de assistente social para demandas de inseguranças financeiras, problemas de saúde, orientações sobre benefícios sociais, dentre outras;
  • Para Gestantes: acompanhamento com equipe multidisciplinar e rodas de conversa mensais;
  • Qualidade de vida: com o TotalPass, você tem acesso a academias e atividades físicas com condições especiais. Mais saúde e bem-estar para o seu dia a dia;
  • Campanhas de saúde: ações mensais de conscientização com base em dados de gestão de saúde, focadas em prevenção e promoção de hábitos saudáveis;
  • Acompanhamento Oncológico: Conjunto de ações para acolhimento, orientações e apoio psicossocial a colaboradores em tratamento oncológico, promovendo maior bem-estar e suporte durante o tratamento.

Rede Américas

Somos a Rede Américas, a rede de assistência à saúde multiplataforma , que tem o propósito de oferecer o cuidado completo na medida certa para a saúde.

Estamos em busca de talentos que acreditam que é possível oferecer a melhor e mais avançada assistência à saúde.

Se você tem paixão por cuidar e acredita na medicina de qualidade, vem ser Rede Américas!

Temos um compromisso com a Diversidade! Incentivamos a candidatura de todos que reconhecem a importância da construção de um ambiente livre de preconceitos, assédio e discriminação. Juntos entregamos o nosso melhor sempre.

Você Assumirá As Seguintes Responsabilidades

  • Envolver-se em todos os aspectos do ciclo de vida de desenvolvimento de software (SDLC), incluindo análise, design, codificação, teste e implementação;

  • Experiência em Angular (incluindo Angular CLI), TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML5 e CSS3, além de familiaridade com ferramentas de build front-end e gerenciadores de pacotes;
  • Conhecimento com Bancos de Dados Relacionais e Oracle, além de experiência com Java Message Service (JMS) e Filas de Mensagens;
  • Fortes habilidades analíticas, capacidade de interpretar requisitos de negócios, e experiência em construir e manter testes automatizados usando JUnit e Mockito.

Desejável

  • Experiência em projetos internacionais;

Acesse go.ey.com/beneficios e conheça nosso universo de benefícios.

Na EY, você se desenvolve com habilidades voltadas para o futuro e se abastece de experiências de classe mundial. Nós capacitaremos você em um ambiente flexível e potencializaremos seus talentos extraordinários em uma cultura diversa e inclusiva, com equipes globalmente conectadas.

title: CRA II
description:
Summary Of Responsibilities

  • Site management responsibility for clinical studies according to Fortrea’s Standard Operating Procedures, ICH GCP Guidelines, applicable project plans and Sponsor requirements, including verification of study training records.
  • Conduct site monitoring responsibilities for clinical trials according to Fortrea’s Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), ICH guidelines and GCP; including Pre-study, Site Initiation, Process Monitoring, Routine Monitoring, and Close-out Visits.
  • Prepares and implements project plans related to Clinical Monitoring responsibilities.
  • Ensures the protection of subjects by verifying that informed consent procedures and protocol requirements are adhered to alongside applicable regulatory requirements.
  • Safeguards data integrity by careful source document review, source document verification, query generation, and resolution against established data review guidelines on Fortrea or client data management systems.
  • Confirms Site Regulatory documents and applicable eTMF/Sponsor Documents are complete and current throughout the duration of the trial.
  • Guarantees that the study Investigational Product inventory and accountability is accurate and that study materials are stored securely and per protocol requirements.
  • Ensures adherence to global quality control and CRA performance metrics.
  • Ensures audit readiness at site level.
  • Acts in the project role of a Lead CRA as assigned.
  • General On-Site Monitoring Responsibilities:
  • Ensure the study staff who will conduct the protocol have received the proper materials and instructions to safely enter subjects/patients into the study. Ensure the protection of study subjects or patients by performing eligibility review, verifying that screening, informed consent procedures and protocol requirements are adhered to according to the applicable regulatory requirements.
  • Ensure the integrity of the source data reported by careful source document review. Monitor data for missing or implausible data.
  • Ensure study data completeness, accuracy, consistency, and compliance; identify deficiencies, deviations and discrepancies, and initiate corrective action as required.
  • Ensure the resources of the Sponsor and Fortrea are spent wisely by performing the required monitoring tasks in an efficient manner, according to SOPs and established guidelines, including managing travel expenses in an economical fashion according to Fortrea travel policy.
  • Travel, including air travel, may be required and is an essential function of the job.
  • Prepare and submit accurate and timely trip reports.
  • Independently perform eCRF review, 100% source data verification, query generation and resolution against established data review guideline with or without direct supervision, on Fortrea or client data management systems, as assigned by management.
  • Assist with the administration of clinical research projects, recruiting investigators (if applicable), collecting investigator documentation and site management.
  • Update, navigate, and maintain Fortrea or study/Sponsor-specific trial management tools/eClinical systems.
  • Track IP shipments and supplies, as needed.
  • Track and follow-up on serious adverse events as assigned.
  • Work closely with the study team, align monitoring to critical study timelines ensuring study deliverables are met.
  • Prepare and implement study-specific monitoring plans and site Initiation slides, as assigned.
  • Attend investigators’ meetings (if applicable), project team meetings and teleconferences, and others as needed.
  • Present training content for site initiation.
  • Assist with training of new employees (e.g., co-monitoring).
  • All other duties as needed or assigned.

Qualifications (Minimum Required)

  • University or college degree, or certification in a related allied health profession from an appropriately accredited institution (e.g., nursing licensure). An equivalent amount of experience can be substituted as appropriate.
  • Thorough understanding of ICH GCP Guidelines and understanding of local regulatory requirements.
  • Thorough knowledge of monitoring procedures.
  • Basic understanding of the clinical trial process.
  • Fluent in local office language and in English, both written and verbal.
  • Fortrea may consider relevant and equivalent experience in lieu of educational requirements.

Experience (Minimum Required)

  • External Candidates: University or college degree, or certification in a related allied health profession from an appropriately accredited institution (e.g., nursing licensure). AND
  • A minimum of 2 years of Clinical Monitoring experience.
  • Internal Candidates: Internal candidates with a minimum of 2 years of Clinical Monitoring experience.
  • Ability to monitor study sites independently according to monitoring plan, project requirements, SOPs, and ICH GCP guidelines.
  • Ability to work with minimal supervision.
  • Have an understanding of the Serious Adverse Event (SAE) reporting, process production of reports, narratives and follow up of SAEs.
  • Good planning, organization, and problem‑solving abilities.
  • Works efficiently and effectively in a matrix environment.

Preferred Qualifications Include

  • Thorough working knowledge of Fortrea SOPs for site monitoring.
  • One (1) or more additional years of experience in a related field (i.e., medical, clinical, pharmaceutical, laboratory, research, data analysis, data management or technical writing) is preferred.
  • Phase I monitoring experience.
  • Life Science or Nursing qualification.
  • Specific skills, systems, certifications, and/or licenses preferred.
  • Personal characteristics (leadership, problem solving, interpersonal skills).
  • Good attention to detail.
  • Methodical approach to work.
  • Good understanding of medical and clinical research terminology and clinical research processes.
  • An understanding of the basics of physiology, pharmacology, and medical devices (when applicable).
  • Good understanding of the principles of ICH GCP, ISO 14155 (if applicable) and local regulatory requirements.
  • Good computer literacy with working knowledge of PCs, Windows and Microsoft Office applications.
  • Good oral and written internal and external communication. Strong interpersonal team and organizational skills, personal presentation. The ability to communicate effectively in English.
  • Focus on Customer.
  • Innovate and Change.
  • Pursue Scientific and Process Excellence.
  • Work with Others.
  • Achieve Results.
  • Ability to maintain confidentiality of data and information during interactions with staff at all levels and across studies and sponsors.
  • Demonstrated ability to conduct clinical operations activities most effectively and efficiently.
  • Good analytical and negotiation skills.
  • Experience using e-clinical systems (e.g., clinical trial management system (CTMS)).
  • For medical device positions, experience in providing customer service to device end users.

Physical Demands/Work Environment

  • Must be able to sit at a computer for long periods of time.
  • Must be able to use hands to finger, handle or touch objects, tools or controls, including a computer keyboard, for up to 8 hours per day.
  • Standard office and/or home working environment.
  • Clinical Research Unit and hospital environment (administrative only).
  • Risk of eye strain.
  • Will involve outside of normal office hours as required by the role.
  • Travel Requirement is 60% of the time (traveling to study sites).

Não buscamos perfeição. Buscamos atitude.

A Diesel nasceu para quem não segue regras prontas, para quem lidera sendo real, imperfeito e autêntico.

Aqui, gerente não é apenas para quem bate meta, é quem inspira, provoca e vive a marca todos os dias.

O Gerente de Loja Diesel é responsável por liderar a operação comercial, garantindo a excelência no atendimento ao cliente, o atingimento de metas de vendas (KPIs) e a manutenção dos padrões visuais e de marca (Visual Merchandising) da Diesel.   • Experiência em Varejo Premium/Luxo: Vivência consolidada em moda, preferencialmente com jeanswear ou marcas de lifestyle premium.
  • Gestão de KPIs: Domínio analítico de conversão, ticket médio, P.A. e metas de vendas.
  • Conhecimento de Visual Merchandising: Capacidade de aplicar diretrizes de VM para aumentar o sell-out.
  • Sistemas de Varejo (ERP/POS): Familiaridade com sistemas de gestão de loja e Excel/Pacote Office.
  • Gestão de Estoque: Controle de inventário, curadoria de produtos e giro de estoque.

Competências Comportamentais (Soft Skills)

  • Liderança Inspiradora: Capacidade de motivar e engajar a equipe em um ambiente de ritmo acelerado.
  • Orientação para Resultados: Foco obsessivo no atingimento de metas e superação de expectativas.
  • Paixão por Moda e Estilo: Conhecimento de tendências e conexão com o público jovem/urbano.
  • Inteligência Emocional: Resiliência e habilidade para lidar com clientes exigentes e situações de alta pressão.

  • Atendimento ao Cliente (CRM): Criar e manter relacionamentos duradouros com clientes (fidelização), gestão da base de clientes (CRM) e resolução de conflitos de forma ágil e proativa.
  • Gestão Operacional e Estoque: Responsável pelo inventário, recebimento de mercadorias, organização do estoque, prevenção de perdas e relatórios financeiros/administrativos.
  • Lifestyle da Marca: Garantir que o ambiente da loja, a música e a postura da equipe reflitam o posicionamento "for successful living" da Diesel.

title: GTM Lead
description:
You will build Bleu's revenue machine from zero.

This is not a role where you inherit a pipeline and optimize it. There is no pipeline. There is:

  • real proof (strong case studies + references)
  • a clear quality bar and delivery track record
  • validated service patterns (we know what works)
  • founders who will work closely with you

Your job is to turn that into a repeatable GTM system.

What you'll own

  • Turn what we already do well into 2–3 clear, repeatable offers (less bespoke proposals every time)
  • Define who we're for — and who we're not for
  • Protect margin and apply guardrails (no vague scope, no "staff aug", no deals that create scope creep)
  • Build the basics in a CRM of your choice (stages, qualification criteria, templates, weekly cadence)
  • Create a proposal/contract process that fits consultative, high-trust sales
  • Close the loop with delivery so we keep selling what we're genuinely best at

Demand generation (hands-on)

  • Outbound + ecosystem work: LinkedIn, warm intros, partner conversations—in Bleu's voice (direct, consultative, substance > hype) — you prospect, qualify, and close while building the sales playbook
  • Turn proof into assets (references, case studies, short narratives) instead of "nice quotes"
  • Work with founders on a consistent content cadence (e.g., ~2 posts/week)

Team (once the system works)

  • Hire and manage a BDR to run the playbook you build, and/or build an AI agent for that.
  • Define what a "qualified meeting" is so the BDR generates real opportunities

What you won't own

  • Product decisions or roadmap
  • Delivery management or post-sale customer success
  • Engineering priorities or team management
  • Brand marketing / creative direction (you'll collaborate with cases and content creation, but you won't be "the brand team")

You'll do well here if you…

  • Have sold or built GTM for technical services / engineering partnerships / productized dev work (not enterprise SaaS-only)
  • Can hold a real conversation with technical buyers (founders, CTOs, eng leads) without fluff
  • Don't think that doing the prospecting yourself is unacceptable — you know that's the job
  • Write clearly and directly (if your default is buzzwords/corporate-speak, this won't fit)
  • Have high autonomy and like building systems (you don't need daily orchestration)
  • Know when to say no to deals that look good on paper but damage margin, scope, or team focus

Nice to have

  • Experience selling to technical buyers in both Web2 and Web3
  • Prior experience hiring/training a BDR
  • Familiarity with the Brazilian market (we're expanding Brazil as a channel too, without losing global focus)

Logistics

  • Remote (timezone range: UTC-8 to UTC+1)
  • Work closely with the founders (José + Fábio) and delivery leads

Hiring process (3–4 weeks)

  • 2. Paid async work sample (~3–4h) — ICP definition, offer framing, 30-day outbound plan, LinkedIn message, pipeline criteria
  • 3. Deep dive (90 min) — work sample presentation + discovery call roleplay + pressure scenarios
  • 4. Final conversation (45 min, both founders) — long-term alignment

Compensation

  • - Base + variable (OTE~ USD 100k/year)

Our company culture blends people-first care and performance excellence. The Rocket represents our ambition and drive; the Heart symoolizes our focus on empathy, integrity, and collective impact.

You can check out independent reviews by other candidates on Glassdoor to check how people find interviewing with us.

Check out our Culture page here

About The Role

We’re looking for an Executive Assistant to provide high-level support to our CEO, Felix, and key stakeholders. You will be the backbone of our executive operations, ensuring that leadership can focus on scaling InPlanet while you manage the complexity of their daily lives with agility, trust, and extreme discretion.

You’ll be the kind of person who is a natural problem-solver, highly organized, and comfortable connecting the dots in a fast-paced environment—always maintaining the highest standards of discretion while handling sensitive information and founder-level matters with absolute trust. You’ll act as a true partner, managing priorities and communication to ensure our founders stay effective and focused on our mission.

The Impact you can make

Your work will directly increase the effectiveness of our CEO and leadership team. By bringing clarity to communication, structure to priorities, and ownership to execution, you enable faster and better decision-making across the company.

You won’t just manage tasks: you will own outcomes , ensuring that priorities move forward and nothing falls through the cracks.

Core working relationships

  • Felix (CEO) – direct report and primary priority for support
  • Key stakeholders (CFO, COO, co-founder) – occasional support for meetings, travel, and specific demands
  • External Partners – coordinating with notaries, providers, and global contacts

Key Responsibilities

  • Structure and manage complex calendars and meetings, prioritizing urgencies and ensuring a smooth schedule
  • Manage executive inboxes, including reading, drafting answers, and prioritizing threads and forwards
  • Provide support for personal agenda and private administrative tasks as needed to optimize the CEO's time
  • Join meetings to collect insights, document action items, and provide clear summaries
  • Lead certain initiatives from start to finish, such as scheduling notary dates and ensuring document readiness
  • Conduct research on specific topics and prepare detailed reports to support business decision-making
  • Organize end-to-end travel arrangements for the CEO and support other founders (COO/CFO) when required
  • Track deadlines and follow up on action items independently, ensuring tasks are completed on time
  • Maintain the highest standards of confidentiality and discretion when handling sensitive information
  • Identify and lead improvements in administrative processes to make them more efficient and scalable

You can be a Rock-Star if you have

  • Proven experience as an Executive Assistant or in a high-level coordination role
  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration or a related field
  • Advanced English and Portuguese communication skills
  • Strong ability to manage multiple priorities and complex schedules
  • Experience handling executive communication and correspondence
  • High level of autonomy and decision-making in ambiguous environments
  • Based in the Campinas / São Paulo region with availability for hybrid work:
    -2 days/week with Felix in Valinhos
    -Travels to Piracicaba

Key Qualities

  • Highly organized and naturally enjoys structuring, prioritizing, and bringing clarity
  • Detail-oriented and outcome-focused: you don’t just start tasks, you finish them
  • Proactive and independent, with confidence to move forward without constant approvals
  • Strong communication skills, both written and verbal
  • Able to connect the dots quickly and understand business context
  • Discreet and trustworthy when handling sensitive information
  • Driven, curious, and motivated to operate at a high level

Bonus Points (but not essential)

  • Experience in fast-paced startups or international environments
  • Previous experience in climate tech, sustainability, or AgTech settings
  • Exposure to legal/financial processes (contracts, notaries, documentation)
  • Strong experience with research, synthesis, and executive-level reporting

Living Our Values

At InPlanet, we have a big vision of solving climate change, and we are looking for individuals who are genuinely passionate about making a positive difference in the world of Carbon Removal Solutions. Trust guides our actions, drive fuels our efforts, and impact is our goal.

  • Trust: You believe in being kind and transparent in the workplace, fostering an environment where trust thrives and collaboration flourishes
  • Drive: You possess an innate drive to take action with a hands-on, can-do attitude, propelled by urgency
  • Impact: You dream big and are committed to making a meaningful difference in the world, aligning with our overarching mission to address climate change
  • Compensation expectations and our compensation philosophy are openly discussed in the first interview with the goal of managing expectations fairly.
  • Home Office Budget
  • Language Programme Monthly Allowance
  • 40 days annual leave
  • The opportunity to be autonomous, make a huge difference and belong to a vision.
  • Occasional off-sites in Brazil yay!
  • Laptop to fuel your productivity

InPlanet Compensation Philosophy

At InPlanet, our philosophy revolves around ensuring fair and unbiased compensation and equitable equity pay, coupled with competitive benefits, across all regions where we operate.

The reason behind our salary range being wide or undefined at the first stages of the interview is because of our international presence and globally distributed workforce, we utilize geo ranges to account for varying pay differentials, forming a crucial part of our global compensation strategy to remain competitive across diverse markets as we expand our reach.

These ranges are determined by role, level, and location, recognizing the nuanced demands of each market. The actual base pay for the selected candidate is influenced by factors such as location, skills, experience, training, business requirements, and market dynamics, with the range subject to potential adjustments in alignment with our commitment to fairness and transparency.

Application Process

Roughly 6 hours across 3-6 weeks from CV-screening.

  • Interview with the Hiring Manager (required core skills and competencies)

(optional third interview)

  • Verbal reference check & psychometric profiling
  • Offer

How To Apply

At DoorDash, we’re on a mission to empower local economies — and that mission drives everything we do. What started as food delivery has evolved into a technology and logistics platform designed to help people access anything in their city, from meals to everyday essentials. We’re building the future of local commerce, and we’re looking for team members excited to be part of that journey.

Joining DoorDash means working in a fast-paced, dynamic environment where your ideas can shape products, impact millions of users, and help merchants, Dashers, and customers thrive. We also care deeply about our team’s well‑being. DoorDash offers comprehensive benefits, including premium healthcare, paid parental leave, wellness reimbursements, and more — because we believe that when our people thrive, our communities thrive too.

As the Engineering Manager, you will oversee a talented group of engineers, collaborating closely with product managers, operation and other cross‑functional partners. Your primary responsibility will be driving the successful execution of our product roadmap, ensuring the timely delivery of high‑quality solutions that meet both customer needs and business objectives. You will be key in fostering a collaborative and cross‑functional work environment and promoting effective communication and synergy amongst team members. This role is ideal for a strategic thinker with strong leadership skills who can balance technical excellence with business priorities.

You're excited about this opportunity because you will…

  • Lead and grow a team of exceptional engineers, empowering through delegation, and delivering end‑to‑end engineering solutions.
  • Collaborate with Product Managers, Business leaders, and key stakeholders to determine the team's roadmap and vision, and manage execution against that roadmap.

description:
A NTS (Nova Transportadora do Sudeste S/A – NTS) transporta gás natural por meio de um sólido sistema de gasodutos, conectando a região mais industrializada do Brasil com segurança e confiabilidade. São mais de 2.000 quilômetros de gasodutos ligando os estados do Rio de Janeiro, Minas Gerais e São Paulo ao gasoduto Bolívia-Brasil, aos terminais de GNL e às plantas de processamento de gás.

Valores

  • Respeito à vida e ao meio ambiente: Nosso compromisso é com a segurança dos nossos funcionários e das comunidades e com a preservação do meio ambiente por onde passamos.
  • Integridade: Atuamos com transparência e comprometimento em todas nossas relações, nos pautando pela legalidade.
  • Foco em resultado: Não nos encantamos com sofisticações desnecessárias. Concentramos nossos esforços no alcance das metas e no foco em resultados.
  • Postura de dono: Olhar além do resultado imediato e tomar a melhor decisão para a empresa é uma atitude de todos os nossos funcionários.

Descrição da Vaga

Estamos em busca de um(a) Engenheiro(a) de Desenvolvimento de Projetos Sênior para atuar no desenvolvimento de projetos de instalações voltadas ao transporte de gás natural. O(a) profissional será responsável pela liderança técnica das entregas, garantindo conformidade às normas regulatórias e excelência na condução de projetos de alta complexidade.

Responsabilidades

  • Atuar no desenvolvimento de projetos de instalações para o transporte de gás natural, como gasodutos, pontos de entrega, pontos de recebimento, estações de compressão, entre outros.
  • Avaliar a documentação técnica dos projetos, garantindo atendimento às normas técnicas e regulamentações vigentes, atuando de forma colaborativa com equipes técnicas multidisciplinares.
  • Desenvolver solicitações de serviços para equipes técnicas e avaliar as propostas recebidas para execução dos serviços.
  • Liderar atividades relacionadas ao desenvolvimento dos projetos, assegurando o cumprimento dos objetivos técnicos, prazos e orçamentos.
  • Elaborar relatórios técnicos.
  • Desenvolver materiais e conduzir reuniões técnicas com clientes internos e externos.

Requisitos

  • Ensino superior completo em Engenharia (Mecânica, Elétrica ou Civil).
  • Sólida experiência em desenvolvimento de projetos.
  • Domínio do Pacote Office (Word, PowerPoint, Excel, Outlook).
  • Conhecimento em normas técnicas como ASME, ASTM, API, NBR, entre outras.

Diferencial

  • Pós-graduação.
  • Conhecimento em softwares de engenharia.
  • Experiência na área de O&G.

Como se preparar para o processo seletivo

  • Pesquise sobre a NTS: Entenda a história, valores e missão da NTS. Visite o site oficial e leia notícias recentes.
  • Revisão de CV: Garanta que seu currículo esteja atualizado e reflita suas habilidades e experiências relevantes.
  • Prepare-se para perguntas: Pense em exemplos concretos de situações em que demonstrou suas habilidades e competências.
  • Conheça a vaga: Entenda as responsabilidades e requisitos da posição para alinhar suas respostas às expectativas da empresa.

Etapas do Processo Seletivo

  • Entrevista com time de Gente: Para discutir mais sobre a empresa, aderência à vaga e expectativas.
  • Entrevista com o Gestor e Business Partner: Para conversar sobre aspectos do dia a dia, conhecimento técnico e carreira.

Por que trabalhar conosco?

Na NTS, você encontra um ambiente dinâmico, inclusivo e acolhedor, onde as pessoas são valorizadas e têm espaço para crescer. Acreditamos no poder da diversidade, da colaboração e do desenvolvimento contínuo. Oferecemos oportunidades reais de aprendizado e evolução profissional, com programas estruturados e incentivo ao protagonismo de carreira. Nosso pacote de benefícios é completo e pensado para cuidar de você em todas as fases da vida.

  • Plano de saúde de qualidade
  • Previdência privada
  • Vale refeição/alimentação (Swile)
  • Auxílio farmácia
  • Auxílio creche
  • Day-off de aniversário
  • TotalPass
  • Participação nos Lucros e Resultados (PLR)

Venha fazer parte de uma empresa que contribui para o desenvolvimento do Brasil, garantindo o transporte seguro e sustentável de gás natural. Venha transportar o futuro conosco!

Eurasia Group is the world's leading global research and advisory firm. We help clients understand, anticipate, and respond to instability and opportunities everywhere they do business. Together with GZERO Media—the go-to source of first insight into geopolitics—and our full‑fledged events team, the Eurasia Group umbrella provides a complete political risk solution.

Headquartered in New York, we have offices in Washington, London, São Paulo, Brasília, Tokyo, Singapore, and San Francisco, as well as on‑the‑ground experts in more than a hundred countries in every region of the world. We are committed to analysis that is free of political bias and the influence of private interests.

Position Overview

Eurasia Group is seeking a high‑performing sales operations associate in São Paulo. This entry‑level sales operations support role includes a wide range of responsibilities, with an emphasis on proactive collaboration, strong communication, and organizational skills to complete tasks for a wide range of activities supporting our sales activities. In return, the hire will be a part of a dynamic sales operations team, working closely with business development staff and analysts, at the world’s market‑leading political risk advisory firm in an increasingly critical market space.

The sales operations associate will spend a majority of their time supporting our operations, business development, and analyst teams, reporting to the associate director, with a heavy focus on end‑to‑end management of conference call logistics and comprehensive administrative and operational support for the sales teams. This includes key responsibilities in account management (with a focus on CRM management and reporting), and responding to time‑sensitive, ad‑hoc sales requests as they arise. We are looking for someone with appropriate project management experience and a positive can‑do attitude. Given the varying nature of our business development needs and operations change management at the firm, you will need to be a quick learner, a versatile problem solver, and thrive in an entrepreneurial environment.

Responsibilities

  • Manage conference call logistics, including generation of client registration and attendance reports, call log maintenance, liaising with speakers to ensure a smooth presentation experience, troubleshooting technical issues, updating the conference call user manual, and providing training to research teams.
  • Support account management efforts across various client services teams including client interaction reporting, contact and account entitlement management in Salesforce, and other recurring account management activities.
  • Respond to client inquiries promptly and professionally, ensuring a positive customer experience.
  • Utilize Eurasia Group’s cloud‑based business intelligence platform to produce regular reports and ad‑hoc analysis of research production and consumption, and analyze readership trends in various segments of the client base.
  • Report regularly on interactions with specific clients to ensure compliance with research‑related regulations.
  • Direct website inquiries to the appropriate client services teams.
  • Approve requests for access to Eurasia Group content on various research aggregation platforms.
  • Ad hoc projects as required.

Required Skills

  • Strong English oral and written communication skills.
  • Demonstrated professionalism, problem solving, teamwork skills, confidentiality, discretion, reliability, and judgment; positive can‑do attitude; someone who will “own” the role.
  • Agility and flexibility in response to changing priorities and needs.
  • Fluency with MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Zoom, and Salesforce.com CRM system and ability to pick up and learn new technologies as needed.
  • Strong analytical skills and attention to detail.
  • Ability to meet deadlines.

Additional Requirements

  • Undergraduate/first‑level degree (e.g., bachelor’s degree) desired with coursework in business administration or related field.
  • 1‑2+ years’ experience in a professional services environment, especially a corporate sales, operations, or events function.
  • Experience interfacing with multinational corporations.
  • A strong interest in international affairs and politics, including an understanding of Eurasia Group’s core services.

At Eurasia Group, our mission is to provide the tools and understanding needed in a world where politics drives disruption. We put politics first for our clients, and we aspire to be the leading place people come to find out about the world. This requires us to maintain a company culture that puts people first. We are committed to fostering an environment that is empowering and globally minded. We firmly believe that bringing people with a variety of ideas and perspectives to the table makes our analysis stronger for our clients and creates a better workplace. Our leadership team is dedicated to embedding this approach into everything we do and how we lead because we care deeply about our work and our people.

title: Commercial Strategy Specialist
description:
AB InBev is the leading global brewer and one of the world’s top 5 consumer product companies. With over 500 beer brands, we’re number one or two in many of the world’s top beer markets, including North America, Latin America, Europe, Asia, and Africa.

About ABI Growth Group

ABI’s Growth Division is the center of innovation and tech development within ABI, which is driving ABI’s growth by developing innovations for the core beer business and creating new hyper‑growth tech businesses. ABI Growth includes the following business lines: BEES (our business‑to‑business e‑commerce and SaaS business, also focused on new technologies), TaDa and Ze Delivery (our direct‑to‑consumer e‑commerce businesses), and several other high‑tech divisions, including fintech and venture capital.

This role will be largely dedicated to BEES, which is on a mission to transform ABI’s business‑to‑business sales model by putting customers and data at its heart. Whether you are a small to medium sized retailer or a supplying partner, BEES provides you with the tools, data, and insights you need to help your business thrive. Today, more than 2.5 million retailers across 19 countries use BEES every month to browse for products, place orders, earn rewards, arrange deliveries, manage invoices, and access business insights all from one place.

Learn more on how BEES keeps business buzzing at

About the Role

The Commercial Strategy Specialist is responsible for maximizing profitable growth across BEES Link 3P through strong governance, analytical rigor, and scalable operating standards. Aligned with our mission — to maximize profitable growth by institutionalizing pricing compliance, P&L governance, disciplined product prioritization, and scalable operating processes — this role plays a critical part in strengthening the structural foundations of our commercial model.

This position sits at the intersection of Commercial, Product, Finance, and Operations. The Commercial Strategy Specialist transforms complex business problems into data‑driven insights and scalable frameworks that protect margins, improve investment allocation, and accelerate disciplined decision‑making. This is a high‑impact role designed for a senior professional who combines strategic thinking with hands‑on analytical execution.

What you'll do

  • Own P&L governance for BEES Link 3P, consolidating partner‑level performance data and translating it into clear visibility on margin health, revenue quality, and profitability trends.
  • Provide broad‑ranging legal advice to other teams across ABI Growth, including relating to SaaS and licensing transactions, strategic commercial relationships, data monetization strategies, data privacy projects, and product counseling.
  • Build and maintain scalable operating frameworks — standard templates, decision criteria, governance protocols — that reduce dependency on ad hoc judgement and improve process consistency.
  • Drive product prioritization rigor by developing structured intake processes, effort‑impact scoring models, and backlog governance routines that align roadmap decisions with commercial outcomes.
  • Design and maintain investment evaluation frameworks that assess initiatives against a shared value logic, distinguishing between cost avoidance, governance improvement, and incremental revenue generation.
  • Develop and update reference models for take rate and GMV impact analysis, enabling leadership to make pricing and product decisions grounded in real partner data.
  • Identify operational bottlenecks and inefficiencies across the OTC and GTM cycle, and lead initiatives to eliminate waste and improve execution speed without compromising governance standards.
  • Synthesize cross‑functional inputs — from Commercial, Finance, Product, and Operations — into integrated business reviews that surface risks early and enable proactive course correction.
  • Support JBP structuring and partner onboarding processes by providing analytical and governance scaffolding that ensures new engagements are commercially sound from the outset.

What you'll need

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Economics, Engineering, or a related quantitative field; advanced degree (MBA, MSc) is a strong differentiator.
  • Experience in a business analytics, commercial operations, strategy, or financial governance role, ideally within a technology, marketplace, or CPG environment.
  • Proven ability to build and operationalize governance frameworks, pricing models, or P&L management tools in complex, multi‑stakeholder environments.
  • Strong analytical proficiency — advanced Excel/Google Sheets, SQL, or Python/R — with the ability to work directly with large datasets and translate findings into executive‑level insights.
  • Demonstrated experience with take rate modelling, GMV analysis, or margin management in a platform or marketplace business is a significant plus.
  • Desire to help build the legal function and data privacy program from the ground up.
  • Effective communicator who can synthesize complex analytical work into clear business narratives for senior leadership and cross‑functional partners.
  • Practical legal approach, focused on enabling the business strategy rather than a compliance‑first mindset.
  • Fully fluent in English and Portuguese; proficiency in Spanish is a plus.

title: Senior/Staff Product Designer
description:
Overview

The AI orchestration of your wildest imagination. n8n is the open workflow orchestration platform built for the new era of AI. We give technical teams the freedom of code with the speed of no-code, so they can automate faster, smarter, and without limits. Backed by a fiercely inventive community and 500+ builder-approved integrations, we’re changing the way people bring systems together and scale ideas for impact.

Since our founding in 2019, we’ve grown into a diverse team of over 220 - working across Europe and the US, connected by a shared builder spirit and with our centre of gravity in Berlin. Along the way, we’ve:

  • Cultivated a community of more than 650,000 active developers and builders
  • Earned 145k+ GitHub stars, making us one of the world’s Top 40 most popular projects
  • Been ranked as one of Europe’s most promising privately held SaaS startups (4th in Sifted’s 2025 B2B SaaS Rising 100)
  • Raised $240m to date, from Sequoia’s first German seed to our recent $180m Series C - bringing us to a $2.5bn valuation

That’s the company we’ve built. Now we’d love to see what you can build. If you’re applying, try n8n out - whether you’re technical or not - and share a screenshot of your first workflow with us. The easiest place to start is here: app.n8n.cloud/register.

We’re in a defining moment of an incredible journey. Come and build with us.

Role

We’re looking for a seasoned Product Designer who thrives in ambiguity and challenging problem spaces.

n8n is a powerful, flexible technical tool, which means the problems you tackle as a designer are complex. Your design decisions must account for diverse user workflows, technical constraints, and how changes impact the entire platform. To thrive here, you will need to love talking to users, understanding technology, and reducing complexity and scope.

We’re currently hiring for different teams with specific focus on:

  • Enterprise: You’ve worked on technical B2B platforms where workflows are the product. You’ve designed for scale, governance and collaboration across teams including permissions, environments, observability and failure modes included and you’re comfortable making deeply complex systems feel coherent and simple.
  • AI: This team is perfect for designers who’ve worked on AI tools, agents, or builders and want to push the boundaries of AI-powered automation. You'll define the future of AI-powered workflows.
  • Growth: We're seeking a designer who thrives on rapid iteration and experimentation. You have experience optimizing onboarding and activation flows, you're motivated by moving metrics, and you excel at testing, learning, and iterating quickly.
  • Marketplace: This role is ideal for designers experienced with multi-sided platforms where you balance distinct needs of the supply and demand sides. You'll build something new from the ground up in a brand new team.

Our team structure evolves quickly and these team assignments may shift in the coming weeks.

Regardless of the team your main goal will be to lead end-to-end product design on complex workflows that elevate n8n’s user experience, ship measurable outcomes, and raise the quality bar across our platform. To do so, here are your responsibilities:

Responsibilities

  • End-to-end product design: Lead the full design process for your team, from discovery to polished delivery, collaborating closely with PMs and engineers.
  • Consistently ship high-quality, visually cohesive designs that improve the overall UX at every release.
  • Work effectively on complex features with a strong engineering mindset and understanding of the underlying technology.
  • Take ownership of complex, multi-faceted problems and drive them to completion with initiative and autonomy.

Research, feedback, and UX quality

  • Champion the user by running interviews, usability tests, and research to inform critical product and business decisions.
  • Master the feedback loop by gathering, synthesizing, and acting on input while giving actionable critique to elevate teammates’ work.
  • Balance speed and quality in an MVP-driven environment, navigating ambiguity while maintaining a high bar.

Systems thinking and platform coherence

  • Design in systems, integrating solutions into the broader n8n platform and safeguarding the product’s big picture.
  • Account for edge cases, constraints, and interaction details so users never end up in impossible states.
  • Collaborate across teams and designers to ensure consistency and quality across shared patterns and components.

Strategy, impact, and innovation

  • Shape team strategy by influencing planning, prioritization, and scope with a strong design perspective tied to KPIs.
  • Explore and adopt AI and automation tools to push the boundaries of design practice and AI-powered workflows.

Requirements

Must-haves

  • Product design excellence: You’re proficient across product design, UX, UI, and qualitative research, delivering polished, detail-oriented work.
  • 🧠 Technical mindset: You collaborate effectively with engineers and understand how software is built, including common web technologies.
  • 🧭 Ownership & delivery: You’ve shipped end-to-end features in smaller teams or startups and can drive complex problems to measurable outcomes.
  • ⚡ Fast, focused execution: You operate at high speed in an MVP-driven environment, balancing quality and velocity amid ambiguity.
  • Outcome orientation: You use research and metrics to inform decisions and consistently deliver solutions that enable team KPIs.
  • 🤝 Feedback & collaboration: You’re open and non-defensive in critique and provide actionable feedback that raises the team’s bar.
  • 🧪 Curiosity for AI: You’re enthusiastic about AI and innovation, actively exploring new tools and approaches to advance the craft.
  • Experience level: You have 5+ years in product design with demonstrable impact on shipped products.

Nice-to-haves

  • Front-end fluency: You can prototype or collaborate using HTML/CSS/JavaScript frameworks.
  • 🧩 AI & automation domain: You’ve designed AI or automation products; familiarity with n8n is a plus.
  • Process improvement: You proactively refine team rituals and workflows to increase effectiveness.
  • Continuous growth: You invest in your craft and are motivated by creating tangible product and company impact.
  • Discovery frameworks: You know methodologies like Continuous Discovery or Shape Up.
  • Data-informed design: You’re comfortable with metrics, A/B testing, or SQL to guide decisions.
  • 🚀 Entrepreneurial drive: You’ve built startups or side projects that show initiative and creative problem-solving.

Why join us?

At n8n, your work won’t disappear into a slide deck. You’ll lead high-impact design across core product surfaces—shaping AI-powered workflows, enterprise features, growth journeys, or a new marketplace—from discovery to delivery. You’ll join a fast-growing, remote-first company where autonomy, experimentation, and craft matter, partnering closely with PMs and engineers to ship real outcomes to a passionate global community.

Sound like a challenge you’re excited to take on?

Apply now — and help us build the future of automation.

title: Senior Aerospace Systems Safety Engineer
description:
Job Description

At Boeing, we innovate and collaborate to make the world a better place. We’re committed to fostering an environment for every teammate that’s welcoming, respectful and inclusive, with great opportunity for professional growth. Find your future with us.

Boeing Brazil is seeking Senior Aerospace Systems Safety Engineer , reporting to the Safety Manager, working out of the São José Dos Campos office.

The Senior Aerospace Systems Safety Engineer will be responsible for working cross functionally to ensure airplane level safety analyses are appropriately conducted. Understanding the complex integration of airplane systems, human factors, and airplane integration into the operational environment are required in this role. The Airplane Safety deliverables directly feed airplane compliance and require an extreme attention to detail as well as a healthy engineering curiosity.

Our team works hard to build relationships with our customers across all of engineering and the programs. To do this we must be technically savvy, great communicators, and have a passion to learn more. We are involved in every aspect of designing and certifying our products and must maintain an unrelenting focus on compliance, safety, and product integrity without compromise.

If you’re ready for a challenging new role that is critical to the success of our programs then this might be the job for you. Successful candidates will be reliable, trustworthy, and accountable for delivering results. Familiarity with ARP-4754, ARP-4761, safety analysis, and hazard assessments will greatly benefit you in this role.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Provide safety design and analysis expertise to program stakeholders and leadership
  • Validate and verify airplane level safety requirements
  • Develop certification strategies for systems and airplane level safety issues
  • Execute airplane level threat analyses (bird strike, rotorburst, cargo fire, tire and wheel failures, etc.)
  • Ensure adequate redundancy and physical separation of critical systems
  • Lead airplane level safety analyses like Runway Excursion or Airplane Common Mode to ensure integration across multiple functional systems
  • Design and update safety processes according to the last industry standards, regulations, best practices, and lessons

Basic Qualifications (Required Skills/Experience)

  • Must have existing rights to work in Brazil.
  • Must have a bachelor’s degree in engineering.
  • Must be registered or eligible to register with the Engineering and Agronomy Regional Council (Conselho Regional de Engenharia e Agronomia - CREA).
  • Proficient in both verbal and written communications skills in the English Language
  • In depth experience with safety requirements, system safety analysis such as Risk Assessments, Functional Hazard Assessments (FHA), Fault-tree Analysis (FTA), Systems Safety Assessment, and system design or integration.

Preferred Qualifications (Desired Skills/Experience)

  • Familiarity with FAR Part , and industry practices like ARP 4761 & 4754
  • Familiarity working with FAA
  • Experience with certification plan
  • Experience with airplane level threat analyses (bird strike, rotor burst, cargo fire, tire and wheel failures, etc.)

Relocation

This position offers relocation based on candidate eligibility.

Additional Information

This requisition is for a locally hired position in Brazil. Candidates must have current legal authorization to live and work in Brazil. Benefits and pay are determined at the local level and are not part of Boeing U.S. based payroll. Please also submit a CV or resume written in English.

Applications for this position will be accepted through April 15th, 2026.

This is not an Export Control position.

  • Domina gestão de funil: sabe onde o lead para, por quê e como mover
  • Tem experiência com gestão de carteira (Farming): sabe trabalhar o ciclo de vida do cliente (LTV) e não olha apenas para a primeira venda.
  • Trabalha com indicadores no dia a dia — não só no fechamento do mês

  • É operacional: acompanha de perto, não só pelo dashboard
  • Já montou ou reestruturou processo comercial do zero
  • Tem experiência com CRM e cultura de registro no time
  • Vem de comercial B2B com perfil de cliente exigente — e quer aplicar essa visão num B2C em crescimento acelerado
  • Tem curiosidade natural por produto de design, lifestyle ou alto padrão.

Remuneração

Variável atrelado ao resultado do time — conversão, ticket médio e atingimento de meta coletiva

Presencial em São Paulo | Seg–Sex

Acreditamos que o líder precisa ganhar quando o time ganha. Vamos alinhar os números na conversa, com transparência.

Somos uma empresa jovem, em crescimento acelerado, com tudo ainda sendo construído. Isso significa autonomia real, impacto direto e muito espaço para quem quer deixar marca — mas também significa que você vai precisar montar estrutura onde ainda não existe.

Se você precisa de tudo pronto para trabalhar, esse não é o lugar certo. Se você gosta de construir, vai se sentir em casa.

title: GTM Enterprise - Founding Team
description:
The Role

We're looking for an Enterprise Sales to open doors, close strategic deals, and build lasting relationships with large enterprises across Brazil and Latin America.

You won't be selling a commodity. You'll be selling a new product that outperforms established players. You'll need the conviction to pitch it accordingly.

This is a role for someone who can walk into a room of senior executives, translate complex AI into a simple business impact story. And leave with a signed contract.

You’ll own the full sales cycle: from identifying and qualifying accounts, through navigating complex procurement processes, to handing off a live client to our Forward Deployment team. Along the way, you’ll shape how the market perceives Avra. We know that every interaction is a chance to build our reputation as a tier-1 technology company.

Please note - we are not building an LLM, we are not agentic AI, we are not generative. You will sell a predictive AI platform that models data to predict how an SMB will behave: will that SMB pay back their loan? Is that SMB worth targeting with an online ad? Will that SMB be receptive to a cross-sell?

What You’ll Do

Hunt and close enterprise accounts. Prospect, qualify, and develop new opportunities with large strategic accounts: financial institutions, marketplaces, distributors. Any enterprise with significant B2B operations. You own the pipeline from first touch to signed contract.

Own the pre-sales narrative. Develop compelling, tailored presentations for every audience: from data teams who want to see model performance, to C-level executives who need to understand business impact. You’ll translate our AI platform into a clear and persuasive story.

Drive adoption through handover. You don't disappear after the signature. You’ll guide the client through early implementation, working hand-in-hand with our Forward Deployment team to ensure a smooth transition and fast time-to-value.

Sell with conviction and data. You take a data-driven approach. You know the time to sale and time to production for each of your deals. You use numbers to qualify opportunities, structure proposals, and negotiate pricing that reflects the value Avra delivers.

Be the voice of the market internally. Share customer learnings, competitive intelligence, and market signals with product, engineering, and leadership. Your insights from the field will directly influence product roadmap and company strategy.

What You’ll Bring

Proven enterprise sales track record. 4+ years in B2B sales, consistently meeting or exceeding targets. You've sold into large, complex organizations and know how to navigate multi-stakeholder procurement cycles with minimal hand-holding.

Experience selling new products. At least 2 years selling something that was either new to your organization or new to the market. You know what it takes to create a category, educate buyers, and close when there's no established playbook.

Startup DNA. You've worked in a hyper-growth tech environment before. You thrive in ambiguity. You build your own processes, move fast, and don't wait for permission.

Executive presence. You're comfortable in a room with C-level stakeholders. You communicate with clarity and confidence, negotiate with backbone, know when to push and when to listen.

Strategic deal structuring. You think creatively about how to structure deals… Bundling use cases? Sure. Landing in one department to expand across the organization? Check. Designing partnerships that create long-term value for both sides? Win-win.

Curiosity and a growth mindset. You're genuinely interested in how businesses work, where they struggle, and how technology can change the game. You ask sharp questions and are never satisfied with surface-level answers.

Comfort with technical products. You don't need to be a data scientist, but you need to hold your own in conversations about AI models, data infrastructure, and analytical workflows. You bridge the gap between what our engineers build and what the market needs to hear.

Nice to Have

  • Experience selling to financial institutions, fintechs, or large B2B platforms
  • Background in credit, risk, marketing/growth or data analytics
  • Consulting or product management experience that sharpened your strategic thinking

Why Avra

  • You’ll sell a product that demonstrably outperforms the competition - the technology is already in production with real world results
  • You’ll help define how a category-defining company goes to market
  • You’ll be part of a small, high-caliber team where your work has immediate, visible impact
  • Competitive compensation with meaningful upside tied to performance

Job Title: Marketing Lead (HubSpot- RevOps)

Location: Hybrid (Batel, Curitiba, 3 days in-office – 2 days remote)

Reports To: CEO

About RevBlack

RevBlack is a rapidly growing Revenue Operations consultancy. We help companies solve hard problems, optimize their revenue engines, and scale. We don't do "bare minimum" work; we are dedicated to building outstanding things. We are looking for a long-term partner (5+ years) to join our team, own the marketing function entirely, and drive our next phase of growth.

The Role

RevBlack is seeking a Marketing Lead (HubSpot- RevOps) to drive our revenue-generation ecosystem. This is a high-stakes "Player-Coach" role designed for a professional who seamlessly bridges the gap between visionary strategy and technical CRM execution. You will take charge of a specialized three-person squad (Content, Design, and Ops) that possesses high potential and is ready to reach elite performance levels under a culture of radical ownership.

This is not a position for an "overseer" who stays in the shadows of delegation. You must be eager to own our technological stack, master our data architecture, and execute the growth roadmap. Your primary objective is to accelerate our pipeline through surgical engagement with Private Equity partners and the delivery of premium-tier content.

Your Core Responsibilities

1. Leadership & Accountability (The "Coach")

  • Team Orchestration: Supervise the daily production of our creative and administrative talent. Your mission is to professionalize their output and elevate their standards through active development and clear performance benchmarks.
  • Commitment to Craftsmanship: We have zero tolerance for "average." You will audit every campaign and piece of copy to ensure it aligns with our high-end standards of excellence. AI should be leveraged for scale, but it must never replace human market intelligence or creative depth.
  • Full Functional Accountability: You are the ultimate authority on marketing outcomes. If a project stalls or a workflow breaks, you don’t shift blame. You lead the correction, the post-mortem analysis, and the strategy to ensure it doesn't happen again.

2. Marketing Operations & Strategy (The "Player")

  • Systems & CRM Architecture: Deep, hands-on mastery of HubSpot is mandatory. You will be responsible for auditing automations, architecting transparent reporting, and ensuring our CRM data is clean, actionable, and scalable.
  • Precision Pipeline Growth: We avoid mass-blast noise. You will design and execute sophisticated, high-touch campaigns aimed specifically at Private Equity operating partners and B2B leadership.
  • High-End Referral Ecosystems: Develop and manage a structured referral engine that maintains a personal, premium feel while being engineered for high-volume scale.
  • Analytics-Based Strategy: You will rely on historical data to identify winning strategies rather than guesswork. You will establish clear KPIs and take 100% responsibility for hitting them.

3. Operational Discipline (EOS)

RevBlack is powered by the Entrepreneurial Operating System (EOS) . In this role, you will be the driving force behind our marketing rhythm. This includes architecting quarterly "Rocks," facilitating high-impact L10 meetings, and maintaining the integrity of the marketing scorecard. While prior EOS exposure is a major asset, a relentless commitment to mastering this framework is mandatory for success.

The Ideal Candidate

  • Veteran B2B Leader: You possess a proven track record of managing talent and scaling revenue within a consultancy or professional services environment.
  • MarTech Specialist: Deep, hands‑on expertise in HubSpot (Marketing Ops) is non‑negotiable. We also value familiarity with Webflow and a strategic approach to SEO.
  • Pipeline Architect: You are obsessed with results, not just "vanity metrics." You know how to build a sales pipeline that is both measurable and predictable.
  • Radical Candor: You thrive in an environment of high standards. You provide feedback that is direct, productive, and aligned with The RevBlack Diamond Rule .
  • Strategic Owner: You don’t wait for a roadmap; you build it. You bring the CEO solutions and fresh perspectives, viewing every obstacle as a catalyst for growth.

Our Core Values

We hire, fire, review, and reward based on these values.

  • 100% Responsibility: We own our choices and outcomes. We don’t make excuses, blame others, or hide mistakes.
  • The Obstacle is the Way: We don't just endure challenges; we get curious about them. We turn negatives into positives and use obstacles to improve our condition.
  • Set and Meet Expectations: We build trust by being clear about what we will do and when. If we say it will be done, it gets done.
  • Craftsmanship: We take pride in doing great work. We are meticulous, patient, and detail-oriented—like a watchmaker ensuring every piece is perfect.
  • The RevBlack Diamond Rule: We cultivate high emotional intelligence. We ensure that every client and team member feels better, more secure, and more understood after interacting with us

Why Join RevBlack?

  • Impact: You will work directly with the CEO and shape the future of the company.
  • Growth: We are growing year-over-year with big goals for 2026 and beyond.
  • Culture: A high-performance team that solves hard problems together, supports one another, and dislikes office politics.

The Role

This includes addressing edit requests, managing deadlines, resolving order issues, processing claims, and ensuring seamless order management.
